destination.title: Entropy, information and horizon constraints in inflation
destination.question: How do entropy, information and horizon-consistency arguments constrain inflationary observables, duration and dynamics, and which assumptions control their applicability?
destination.summary: A proposed thematic family with several distinct physical questions. Numerical co-membership does not identify their entropy definitions, observables, mechanisms or conclusions. Field-excursion constraints and stage-dependent cosmological entropy prescriptions remain useful adjacent homes.

systems: Inflationary de Sitter and quasi-de Sitter backgrounds
Scalar EFTs, light-state sectors and higher-derivative inflation
targets: Observable primordial information and total reheating volume
Inflationary duration and proposed de Sitter lifetimes
Information paradoxes, scalar excursions and EFT validity
regimes: Exact de Sitter equilibrium and evolving quasi-de Sitter backgrounds
Low-temperature string theory and conjectural high-temperature extrapolation
Reheating, radiation domination and distinct late-time cosmological-constant choices
An abstract-level fast-roll reference without a supplied quantitative construction
assumptions: Observer access, entropy prescriptions, matter-production models and quantum-gravity conjectures remain source-specific
No common microscopic state count or universally valid entropy identification is presumed
conventions: Operational mode counting, stochastic Shannon entropy, interaction entanglement and thermal entropy remain distinct
Dimensions, gravitational normalizations and geometric versus potential slow-roll parameters are not unified by membership
includes: Conjecture-motivated bounds and explicitly unresolved constructions
excludes: A universal prohibition of eternal inflation
A common numerical e-folding or lifetime bound
Microscopic certification of de Sitter states
A potential-gradient condition valid for all kinetic theories

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: How can a finite de Sitter entropy constrain observations when an inflationary region expands into many causally separated Hubble volumes? Ending inflation in a suitable FRW universe turns inaccessible early fluctuations into density modes that can later be observed.

sources.title: The Volume of the Universe after Inflation and de Sitter Entropy

evidence.text: What is the probability distribution of total reheating volume in eternal and non-eternal slow-roll inflation, and does it imply a quantum probabilistic bound on finite volume in terms of de Sitter entropy?

sources.title: Universe's Primordial Quantum Memories

evidence.text: Could entropy-carrying quantum memory preserve primordial information through inflation, including information preceding its final approximately 60 e-foldings, and could its growing burden contribute to de Sitter quantum breaking?

sources.title: Black hole production, eternal inflation, and information in quasi-de Sitter space

evidence.text: Can suppressing black-hole production from accumulated inflationary fluctuations reproduce the no-eternal-inflation condition, and when does horizon radiation cause an information paradox or threaten complementarity?

sources.title: Entanglement entropy of cosmological perturbations

evidence.text: How much momentum-space entanglement entropy do minimal gravitational nonlinearities generate between super-Hubble scalar perturbations and sub-Hubble modes, and what conditional limit on inflation follows from comparison with reheating entropy?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Replace a model-specific fluctuation analysis by the adiabatic time-shift sector of a spatial-diffeomorphism-invariant effective action. This isolates a necessary source of dangerous fluctuations without requiring a complete microscopic matter Lagrangian.

sources.title: The Volume of the Universe after Inflation and de Sitter Entropy

evidence.text: A multi-type Galton–Watson branching process supplies generating functions. Its continuum limit gives f̈−2√Ω ḟ+f log f=0, with derivatives in τ, f(0;z)=e^(−z), and ḟ(τb;z)=0.

sources.title: Universe's Primordial Quantum Memories

evidence.text: Entropy and energy-budget estimates use E_dS∼SH and order S emitted quanta of energy H. High-harmonic counting estimates ε_k∼√N ε₀ and typical unactualized pattern cost ε_pat∼N^(3/2)ε₀.

sources.title: Entanglement entropy of cosmological perturbations

evidence.text: The retained cubic interaction is H_int=(M_Pl²/2)∫d³x ε_H²aζ²∂²ζ. Selection neglects nonlocal terms, terms containing ζ̇ after super-Hubble freeze-out, and higher slow-roll orders.

sources.title: Black hole production, eternal inflation, and information in quasi-de Sitter space

evidence.text: Uses the gauge-invariant inflaton/metric fluctuation, its approximately free two-point function, and accumulation of frozen modes. A Gaussian tail probability is compared with the exponentially increasing number of causal patches to estimate eternal inflation.

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Use species-selective thermal contact to exploit unequal Hawking temperatures. Adjust the reservoirs until energy balance isolates an apparent second-law violation, then assess whether additional accessible interior or interaction entropy invalidates the proposed accounting.

sources.title: De Sitter quantum breaking, swampland conjectures and thermal strings

evidence.text: Can censorship of de Sitter quantum breaking yield both no-eternal-inflation and de Sitter swampland bounds, with their different strengths arising from low- and high-temperature string regimes?

sources.title: Constraints on the Duration of Inflation from Entanglement Entropy Bounds

evidence.text: Does requiring the interaction-generated entanglement entropy of inflationary long-wavelength perturbations to respect a horizon entropy bound impose an upper duration for inflation and an associated de Sitter lifetime?

sources.title: Stochastic inflation and entropy bound in de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: Can the inflationary e-folding restriction be expressed as an information bound using stochastic inflaton entropy, and can volume weighting supply entropy behavior that respects the de Sitter horizon bound during eternal inflation?

sources.title: Implication of the swampland distance conjecture on the Cohen–Kaplan–Nelson bound in de Sitter space

evidence.text: Can the energy carried by states becoming light along an inflaton trajectory deform a de Sitter horizon enough to restrict the effective theory and prevent eternal inflation?

sources.title: Holography, the cosmological constant and the upper limit of the number of e foldings

evidence.text: If present acceleration comes from a positive cosmological constant, can entropy bounds constrain the total number of inflationary e-foldings, and how does that constraint depend on inflationary energy densities, reheating and subsequent cosmic evolution?

destination.title: Nonsingular cosmological histories and NEC consistency
destination.question: Under which dynamical, geometric and quantum assumptions can contracting or asymptotically low-energy cosmologies avoid singularities, control fluctuations and support viable subsequent evolution?
destination.summary: Retain a broad family spanning bounce mechanisms, preparation, perturbations, higher-dimensional constructions, Genesis and quantum alternatives. Treat general NEC results as conditional consistency questions. The original numerical collection is not defensible as uniform scientific membership; several sources concern different physical targets.

systems: Specified scalar, fermionic, thermal and gravitational cosmological models
FRW and explicitly described homogeneous anisotropic backgrounds
targets: Local stability, EFT control and complete-history regularity
Contraction preparation, smoothing and primordial fluctuations
Genesis and quantum alternatives to singular evolution
regimes: Classical and quantum mechanisms remain distinct
Local bounce intervals and complete histories remain distinct
Flat and positively curved backgrounds remain distinct
Ordinary and pre-Swampland work remains eligible
assumptions: SNEC and accumulated field-path budgets are conditional proposals
An announced stable construction does not establish universal stability or UV completion

conventions: Cosmological contraction-to-expansion bounces are distinguished from Euclidean false-vacuum bounces
Einstein-frame, brane-observer and bulk descriptions are retained separately

includes: Conditional dark-energy applications of NEC consistency
Quantum bouncing models despite their outside-source probe labels
excludes: Plasma shock formation and beam-instability hierarchies as cosmological members
Compact-star viability as a bounce question
Generic modified-gravity reconstruction or moduli acceleration without a stated bounce connection
Potential-free inflation and false-vacuum decay as contraction-to-expansion mechanisms
Unspecified longitudinal/transverse response as an identified cosmological system

sources.title: Ekpyrotic and Cyclic Cosmology

evidence.text: Can slow contraction before the big bang explain cosmological smoothness and primordial perturbations, support repeated cycles connected to dark energy, and admit a viable M-theory embedding with observational signatures?

sources.title: A Matter Bounce By Means of Ghost Condensation

evidence.text: Can a ghost condensate with a suitable potential produce a nonsingular matter bounce resistant to radiation and anisotropic stress while preserving the long-wavelength spectrum originating from vacuum fluctuations during matter contraction?

sources.title: Bouncing Galileon Cosmologies

evidence.text: Can the conformal Galileon support nonsingular homogeneous, isotropic bounces leading into Galilean Genesis, with controlled perturbations and an observationally suitable primordial spectrum?

sources.title: G-Bounce

evidence.text: Can a spatially flat Friedmann universe bounce in standard general relativity through NEC violation while avoiding scalar ghosts and gradient instabilities near the turnaround, and what obstructs a controlled complete cosmological history?

sources.title: The Null Energy Condition and its violation

evidence.text: Can scalar theories with second-derivative Lagrangians but second-order equations violate the null energy condition without evident instabilities, and support Genesis, cosmological bounces or laboratory universe creation? This is a mini-review of selected examples.

sources.title: The CST bounce universe model — A parametric study

evidence.text: Which CSTB parameters and initial conditions permit a single nonsingular bounce leading toward radiation domination, with enough locked-era and subsequent evolution to address horizon, homogeneity, flatness, and singularity problems?

sources.title: Bouncing Cosmologies: Progress and Problems

evidence.text: Can contracting/bouncing cosmologies address the primordial singularity, generate observed near-scale-invariant perturbations, and yield signatures distinguishable from inflation?

sources.title: Fully stable cosmological solutions with a non-singular classical bounce

evidence.text: Can a stable, finite-size NEC-violating classical bounce be embedded in a cosmology that remains nonsingular and stable throughout its entire contracting and expanding evolution, rather than only during the bounce stage?

sources.title: Nonsingular bounces catalyzed by dark energy

evidence.text: Can positive spatial curvature and positive vacuum energy connect contraction to expansion without a classical singularity or null-energy violation? The paper investigates homogeneous anisotropic examples and restrictions on their initial data.

sources.title: Banks-Zaks Cosmology, Inflation, and the Big Bang Singularity

evidence.text: Can the thermal average of Banks-Zaks theory near an IR conformal point violate the NEC and generate nonsingular cosmological backgrounds, including bounces, cyclic universes, and exponential expansion, without a fundamental scalar-field mechanism?

sources.title: Spectrum of Cuscuton Bounce

evidence.text: Can a nonsingular Cuscuton bounce generate nearly scale-invariant scalar seeds without an inflationary phase, and are its tensor perturbations stable and potentially observable?

sources.title: Swampland bounds on dark sectors

evidence.text: Can a rolling scalar coupled to a thermal gauge bath dynamically reduce the cosmological constant, generate observed inhomogeneities, and pass through a crunch and UV-mediated bounce into a hot expanding universe?

sources.title: Perturbative unitarity and NEC violation in genesis cosmology

evidence.text: Do stable NEC-violating genesis backgrounds satisfy tree-level perturbative-unitarity requirements, and do the beyond-Horndeski operators that address classical instabilities also supply the new physics indicated by scattering bounds?

sources.title: How much null-energy-condition breaking can the Universe endure?

evidence.text: If the conjectured smeared null energy condition (SNEC) holds, how does it constrain the magnitude and duration of cosmological NEC violation, particularly phantom/quintom dark energy and nonsingular bounces?

sources.title: On the null energy condition and cosmology

evidence.text: Can ghost-condensate and nonlocal string-tachyon models consistently support NEC violation for phantom dark energy or cosmological bounces, once higher-derivative spectra and possible ordinary-particle decays are considered?

sources.title: New Ekpyrotic cosmology

evidence.text: Can slow ekpyrotic contraction generate nearly scale-invariant curvature perturbations and connect to expansion through a nonsingular, perturbatively controlled bounce entirely within four-dimensional effective theory?

sources.title: A Smooth bouncing cosmology with scale invariant spectrum

evidence.text: Can an explicit, smooth bounce remain within four-dimensional effective theory while a separate isocurvature field supplies approximately scale-invariant perturbations, and what scalar tilt, tensor signal and non-Gaussianity follow?

sources.title: Ekpyrotic and Cyclic Cosmology

evidence.text: Gauge-invariant scalar and tensor mode equations are solved using Bessel/Hankel functions and vacuum boundary conditions. Non-Gaussianity is treated through second-order perturbation equations, the δN formalism for ekpyrotic conversion, and reported numerical comparisons.

sources.title: A Matter Bounce By Means of Ghost Condensation

evidence.text: Numerically solve the homogeneous scalar and Friedmann equations using Mathematica with data imposed at the bounce. The example uses α=4, M=2×10^(−3), V=1/(φ⁴+10¹²), and ρm(0)=10^(−12), in the stated Planck units; it demonstrates a chosen solution rather than generic initial-condition selection.

sources.title: Bouncing Galileon Cosmologies

evidence.text: Solve asymptotic scalar and tensor mode equations; analyze curvaton Bessel solutions by sub-Hubble matching and super-Hubble expansion, then compare curvaton and background density scalings.

sources.title: G-Bounce

evidence.text: Supply a sufficient, explicitly non-necessary hierarchy of Lagrangian inequalities for a healthy bounce, together with κκ,X>0 and normal matter w≥−1. The authors use the freedom in K and κ to argue that satisfying local bounce conditions is straightforward.

sources.title: The Null Energy Condition and its violation

evidence.text: Diagnoses perturbations through L²χ=(Uχ̇²−V(∂iχ)²−Wχ²)/2 and Uω²=Vp²+W. For nondegenerate multiple-field kinetic terms, positive-definite U and V are necessary to exclude high-momentum ghosts and gradient instabilities; low-momentum behavior requires separate analysis.

sources.title: The CST bounce universe model — A parametric study

evidence.text: Particle horizons are estimated by integrating da/(Ha²) through expansion phases. A large-T field redefinition to σ permits a first-order-in-λ scalar expansion used to estimate contraction e-folds up to the onset of deflation.

sources.title: Cosmological Perturbations Through a Non-Singular Ghost-Condensate/Galileon Bounce

evidence.text: How do initially classical curvature perturbations propagate through a non-singular ghost-condensate/Galileon bounce: are their amplitudes and spectrum preserved, amplified, suppressed, or destabilized?

sources.title: Dark energy, extra dimensions, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can an explicit compactification produce a stable NEC-violating component whose dynamics follow the four-dimensional matter–dark-energy transition while satisfying cosmological observations?

sources.title: Spinor driven cosmic bounces and their cosmological perturbations

evidence.text: Can fermion bilinears sourcing nondynamical torsion replace the big bang with a classical nonsingular bounce, while supporting viable background evolution and stable cosmological perturbations?

sources.title: Ekpyrotic cosmology with a zero-shear S-brane

evidence.text: Can a zero-shear S-brane transfer scalar fluctuations from ekpyrotic contraction into an expanding phase with a nearly scale-invariant spectrum and acceptable tensor-to-scalar amplitude, and what conditional consistency relations follow?

sources.title: On the generation of a scale invariant spectrum of adiabatic fluctuations in cosmological models with a contracting phase

evidence.text: Can vacuum fluctuations during contraction generate a scale-invariant adiabatic curvature spectrum that survives a nonsingular transition to expansion? Can two evolving scalar fields provide additional candidate backgrounds for this purpose?

sources.title: Quantum Effects in Cosmology

evidence.text: How do quantum fluctuations affect contracting cosmological backgrounds, and can quantum bouncing models support primordial magnetogenesis and a consistent affine quantization of Brans–Dicke cosmology?

sources.title: Phase-resolved field-space distance criteria in ekpyrotic, bouncing, and cyclic cosmologies

evidence.text: How does sharing a finite scalar trajectory-length budget among ekpyrotic smoothing, entropy conversion, a bounce and subsequent evolution constrain fast roll, anisotropy suppression and observationally viable perturbations?

sources.title: Bouncing branes

evidence.text: Can a five-dimensional Kachru–Shulz–Silverstein scenario with classical scalar matter and a rolling fifth radius support a Tolman cosmological bounce, describing contraction followed by expansion through a minimum spatial volume?

sources.title: Conjecture on the avoidance of the big crunch

evidence.text: Can conjectured Planck-scale physics, motivated by a modification of black-hole Hawking temperature, replace a cosmological big-crunch singularity with a smooth bounce?

sources.title: Supersmoothing through Slow Contraction

evidence.text: Does ekpyrotic slow contraction satisfy the authors' four supersmoothing criteria: classical smoothing, stability to generated quantum fluctuations, robustness against large initial deviations from FRW, and sufficiently rapid completion?

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of a principle of finite amplitudes

evidence.text: Can a ghost-condensate scalar support an asymptotically low-energy NEC-violating beginning?

sources.title: Nonsingular bounces catalyzed by dark energy

evidence.text: Can a moving scalar support the curvature-driven bounce during contraction? The relevant requirement is sufficiently small kinetic energy near the turnaround, rather than a potential supporting prolonged slow roll.

sources.title: Small-Field and Scale-Free: Inflation and Ekpyrosis at their Extremes

evidence.text: How do the specified contracting models produce observable density structure? They separate entropy-mode amplification from its later conversion into curvature perturbations and assume that a microphysical bounce preserves long-wavelength information.

sources.title: Minimal conditions for the creation of a Friedman-Robertson-Walker universe from a 'bounce'

evidence.text: What minimum energy-condition violations are required for an FRW universe to pass from contraction through a positive-size minimum into expansion, and can ordinary classical matter models support such a bounce?

sources.title: Causality and the speed of sound

evidence.text: Can matter with sound or signal speeds exceeding c form a physically acceptable relativistic theory, even when its macroscopic equations are covariant and arise from a Lorentz-invariant Lagrangian?

sources.title: k-Essence, superluminal propagation, causality and emergent geometry

evidence.text: Can a regular positive-kinetic background evolve through the NEC boundary? The proposed obstruction is quantum excitation near singular acoustic geometry, extending earlier cosmological arguments.

sources.title: A bouncing cosmology from VECROs

evidence.text: Can VECRO formation, interpreted as a quantum response of the vacuum to contraction, prevent a Big Crunch and produce a nonsingular cosmological bounce within effective Einstein gravity?

sources.title: Null energy condition and superluminal propagation

evidence.text: Under what conditions does null energy condition violation force microscopic instability, and can stable effective field theories violate NEC? The cosmological motivation includes increasing Hubble expansion and effective w < -1.

sources.title: k-Essence, superluminal propagation, causality and emergent geometry

evidence.text: Does a growing Fourier solution in moving coordinates demonstrate instability of the preferred-frame retarded response? The appendix compares kernels constructed with two different definitions of retardation and finds that they agree only on the slow branch.

sources.title: Starting the Universe: Stable Violation of the Null Energy Condition and Non-standard Cosmologies

evidence.text: Can a controlled low-energy theory genuinely violate the NEC without catastrophic instabilities, and which nonstandard FRW histories become possible when the Hubble rate can increase?

sources.title: On bouncing brane worlds, S-branes and branonium cosmology

evidence.text: Can brane observers experience smooth contraction-to-expansion bounces without a physical negative-energy instability in the higher-dimensional theory, including backgrounds without electric fields?

sources.title: The Null energy condition and instability

evidence.text: Under what conditions does NEC violation imply classical, quantum or thermodynamic instability, and how do causality and rotational symmetry constrain possible exceptions and dark-energy models?

sources.title: Unitary null energy condition violation in P(X) cosmologies

evidence.text: Can a single scalar produce NEC violation and an Einstein-frame cosmological bounce while its fluctuations remain classically stable and below their perturbative strong-coupling scale? The focus is on P(Φ,X) theories and whether higher-energy irrelevant operators open a controlled window.

sources.title: Nonsingular bounces catalyzed by dark energy

evidence.text: Can contraction connect quantum mechanically to expansion when positive anisotropy potential forbids a classical turning point? The suggested extension includes anisotropies and uses Picard–Lefschetz contours, but no transition result is established.

sources.title: Nonsingular bounces catalyzed by dark energy

evidence.text: What contraction dynamics can prepare curvature and dark-energy domination while preventing scalar and anisotropy motion from overwhelming the bounce inequalities? Existence of suitable trajectories does not answer this preparation question.

sources.title: Moduli-dependent species scale

evidence.text: Can the species cutoff be computed across moduli space using genus-one topological free energy, and does its maximum define a desert point agreeing with the maximum BPS mass gap?

sources.title: The emergence proposal and the emergent string

evidence.text: Which components of the classical moduli metric and gauge couplings emerge from integrating out light towers up to the species scale? Strong Emergence assumes absent UV kinetic terms; Weak Variant A asks to recover singular asymptotic kinetic behavior without new singularities, while the paper's Variant B additionally asks for some or all orthogonal kinetic terms.

sources.title: A Note on Modular Invariant Species Scale and Potentials

evidence.text: Can modular invariance extend asymptotic species-scale expressions across moduli space in compactifications preserving four supercharges, and relate the resulting cutoff to gravitino masses, scalar potentials and swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Demystifying the Emergence Proposal

evidence.text: Can emergence reproduce exact protected couplings, including normalizations and subleading terms, in asymptotic type IIA moduli-space limits? What replaces an EFT sum truncated at the species scale, and when can the full answer arise from one loop?

sources.title: Species scale in diverse dimensions

evidence.text: Can higher-curvature couplings capture the moduli-dependent species scale across dimensions and supersymmetries, locate its maxima and effective field-space diameters, and support a sharp global bound on its logarithmic gradient?

sources.title: On the species scale, modular invariance and the gravitational EFT expansion

evidence.text: Does the species scale control the gravitational EFT expansion, which curvature operators actually measure that cutoff, and can duality plus asymptotic information define it globally over moduli space?

sources.title: Modular invariant Starobinsky inflation and the Species Scale

evidence.text: Can a duality-invariant potential built from the moduli-dependent species scale support trans-Planckian modulus inflation while respecting an EFT cutoff, and relate inflationary observables to the tower's species count?

sources.title: Some properties and uses of the Species Scale

evidence.text: Can differential equations for moduli-dependent species scales explain asymptotic Swampland constraints, and can using that scale as a loop cutoff generate potentials that stabilize no-scale moduli?

sources.title: Moduli-dependent species scale

evidence.text: Solve hypergeometric Picard–Fuchs equations, match local solutions numerically to an integral symplectic period basis, and evaluate BPS masses M=|Z|. Numerical scans and local period expansions locate minima of F1 and compare selected BPS gaps.

sources.title: The emergence proposal and the emergent string

evidence.text: Contrast the QFT species prescription Λ̃∼Mpl/√Nsp with Nsp counting states below Λ̃, against the black-hole prescription identifying Nsp with the entropy of the smallest EFT black hole. The actual emergence computations use the QFT prescription.

sources.title: A Note on Modular Invariant Species Scale and Potentials

evidence.text: Reviews the imported N=2 black-hole motivation using D0/D4 charges, attractor equations, genus-one higher-derivative corrections and Wald entropy. Special charges with vanishing cubic intersection contribution but nonzero c2i pi yield Smin≈F1 within the supergravity regime.

sources.title: Demystifying the Emergence Proposal

evidence.text: Evaluate BPS Schwinger integrals in a graviphoton background, using the Gopakumar–Vafa representation. For a rigid S², sum D2–D0 central charges over all integer D0 charges; perform the proper-time integral before regulating infinite sums with Riemann ζ-functions. An alternative uses Hurwitz ζ-functions.

sources.title: Species scale in diverse dimensions

evidence.text: Extract a cutoff from a nonzero higher-curvature coefficient: Λs/Mpl,d=(an/â n)^[-1/(2n−2)]. Use R⁴ terms for 32/16 supercharges and protected R² terms for eight. Normalize R⁴ using the 11d Planck scale; compare multiple normalized coefficients in the half-maximal cases.

sources.title: On the species scale, modular invariance and the gravitational EFT expansion

evidence.text: Use Schwinger/worldline one-loop representations, gamma-function integrals, zeta-function tower sums and Poisson resummation to distinguish UV-sensitive terms from finite thresholds. The four-dimensional computation uses a constant self-dual graviphoton background.

sources.title: Species quantum mechanics

evidence.text: Can canonical quantization of EFT moduli yield a species quantum mechanics linking species number, tower mass variation, the asymptotic CRV pattern, dualities and Calabi–Yau period quantization?

sources.title: Taxonomy of Potentials in Asymptotic Limits

evidence.text: Can the exponential moduli-dependence of scalar-potential terms in generic infinite-distance limits be classified discretely, extending particle/brane taxonomy, and can that classification imply asymptotic de Sitter and species-scale bounds?

sources.title: Machine learning the breakdown of tame effective theories

evidence.text: How many distinct ultraviolet state types are needed to determine an EFT cutoff across moduli space, and can the corresponding partition be inferred from a limited collection of labeled moduli-space points?

sources.title: Bounds on Species Scale and the Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can gravitational EFT consistency bound the variation of the species scale throughout moduli space, including its interior, and thereby constrain how rapidly a light tower's mass can vanish?

sources.title: Bounds on field range for slowly varying positive potentials

evidence.text: How does the field-dependent species cutoff restrict the diameter of regions supporting slowly varying positive potentials, and can explicit Calabi–Yau calculations determine the finite shift beyond the leading logarithmic field-range bound?
